source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2025
publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
ghg_unit: kg CO2e (aggregate of all gases; the workbook also lists separate CO2, CH4 and N2O component rows that this subset does not use)
emissions_boundary: Direct combustion only (Scope 1). The same workbook separately publishes upstream well-to-tank factors under Level 1 'WTT- fuels', Scope 3, for example Butane rows 3458-3461 (tonnes 344.30947, litres 0.19765), which are not included here. The two kinds of factor must not be merged into one value or used to double-count a single fuel activity; a properly scoped company inventory may still report combustion as Scope 1 and well-to-tank as Scope 3 as separate activities.
conversion_notes: Values are used exactly as published in the year column; no conversion or rounding was applied.
naming: Each factor keeps its original workbook name here. When persisted, the seed command appends exactly one unit suffix as 'name (unit)' so that two same-year factors with different units never share a stored name; CSV import looks factors up by this stored name plus optional factor_year.
